Form Field

Form Field is a wrapper component that combines a label, input control, help text, and validation messages into a cohesive unit.

Basic Form Field

A simple form field with label and input.

Please enter your first and last name.
HTML 
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Full Name</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter your full name">
  <span class="zak-form-text">Please enter your first and last name.</span>
</div>

Field Variants

Apply border-style variants to the input control with zak-input--filled, zak-input--outlined, zak-input--underline, and zak-input--ghost. All variants work inside a .zak-form-group.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Filled</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input zak-input--filled" placeholder="Filled field">
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Outlined</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input zak-input--outlined" placeholder="Outlined field">
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Underline</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input zak-input--underline" placeholder="Underline field">
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Ghost</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input zak-input--ghost" placeholder="Ghost field">
</div>

Required Indicator

Add a required asterisk to indicate mandatory fields.

We'll never share your email.
Optional - for SMS notifications.
HTML 
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label zak-form-label-required" for="email">Email Address</label>
  <input type="email" id="email" class="zak-input" placeholder="you@example.com" required>
  <span class="zak-form-text">We'll never share your email.</span>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="phone">Phone Number</label>
  <input type="tel" id="phone" class="zak-input" placeholder="(555) 123-4567">
  <span class="zak-form-text">Optional - for SMS notifications.</span>
</div>

Error State

Show validation errors with the danger state class.

Please enter a valid email address.
Password must be at least 8 characters long.
HTML 
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label zak-form-label-required" for="email">Email Address</label>
  <input type="email" id="email"
    class="zak-input zak-form-control-danger"
    value="not-an-email"
    aria-invalid="true"
    aria-describedby="email-error">
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-danger" id="email-error">
    Please enter a valid email address.
  </span>
</div>

Success State

Show successful validation with the success state class.

Username is available!
Email address is valid.
HTML 
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label zak-form-label-required" for="username">Username</label>
  <input type="text" id="username"
    class="zak-input zak-form-control-success"
    value="johndoe"
    aria-describedby="username-msg">
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-success" id="username-msg">
    Username is available!
  </span>
</div>

Complete Form Field

A full-featured form field with all elements.

Maximum 200 characters. HTML is not allowed.
Choose your country of residence.
HTML 
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label zak-form-label-required" for="bio">Bio</label>
  <textarea id="bio" class="zak-textarea" rows="3"
    placeholder="Tell us about yourself..."
    aria-describedby="bio-help"></textarea>
  <span class="zak-form-text" id="bio-help">
    Maximum 200 characters. HTML is not allowed.
  </span>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="country">Country</label>
  <select id="country" class="zak-select">
    <option value="">Select a country</option>
    <option value="us">United States</option>
    <option value="uk">United Kingdom</option>
  </select>
  <span class="zak-form-text">Choose your country of residence.</span>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-form-groupWrapper for label + input + help text
.zak-form-labelField label
.zak-form-label-requiredLabel with required asterisk
.zak-form-textHelp text or validation message
.zak-form-control-successSuccess state on input
.zak-form-control-dangerError state on input

Accessibility

  • Every form field must have a visible <label> associated with the input via for/id.
  • Use aria-describedby to link help text or error messages to the input.
  • Set aria-invalid="true" when the field has a validation error.
  • Use aria-required="true" on required inputs.
  • Error messages should be announced by screen readers — use role="alert" for dynamic errors.
